primary_diagnosis_treated: Metabolic syndrome (obesity-driven insulin resistance) with hypertension, dyslipidaemia, prediabetes, CKD stage 2-3, and obstructive sleep apnoea
nice_guideline_used: CG181 / PH46 / NG28 (Metabolic syndrome components), NG136 (Hypertension), NG106 (CKD/SGLT2i), CG181 (Statins)

medications.dose: Start 2.5 mg PO once daily, titrate every 2‑4 weeks to 5 mg, then to 10 mg as tolerated
medications.duration: Titrate to target dose over 4‑6 weeks, then lifelong – review annually
medications.purpose: Essential hypertension and renal protection in CKD
medications.nice_justification: NICE NG136 recommends ACE‑I as first‑line for hypertension; NICE NG106 recommends ACE‑I for CKD protection
NICE NG136 allows CCB as part of 2‑drug regimen for hypertension

medications.dose: Reduce to 12.5 mg PO once daily
medications.duration: Ongoing – reassess need after BP control, review annually
medications.purpose: Adjunct antihypertensive; dose reduction to limit metabolic side‑effects
medications.nice_justification: NICE NG136 advises thiazide only if needed and at lowest effective dose

medications.duration: Start 20 mg, titrate to 40 mg after 6 weeks if LDL‑C target not met, then lifelong – review lipid panel at 6 weeks and annually
medications.purpose: Dyslipidaemia (LDL‑C 157 mg/dL) and primary CVD prevention
medications.nice_justification: NICE CG181/PH46 recommends statin for QRISK ≥10% or LDL‑C >1.8 mmol/L

medications.dose: Start 500 mg PO nightly with evening meal, increase by 500 mg weekly to 1500‑2000 mg total daily as tolerated
medications.duration: Titrate over 4‑6 weeks, then lifelong – review HbA1c at 3 months and annually
medications.nice_justification: NICE NG28 recommends metformin as first‑line for prediabetes with BMI ≥30 kg/m² or high cardiovascular risk

medications.duration: Indefinite – review renal function and electrolytes at 3 months, then annually
medications.purpose: Renal protection in CKD (eGFR ≥30) and cardiovascular risk reduction
medications.nice_justification: NICE NG106/NG28 recommends SGLT2‑i for CKD with eGFR ≥30 mL/min/1.73 m² irrespective of diabetes status

interactions_checked.interaction: Combined effect may increase serum potassium and reduce renal function
interactions_checked.action: Check serum K⁺ and eGFR 1‑2 weeks after initiation and after each dose change; adjust thiazide dose if hyperkalaemia develops

interactions_checked.interaction: Amlodipine can increase atorvastatin plasma concentrations via CYP3A4 inhibition, raising myopathy risk
interactions_checked.action: Start atorvastatin at 20 mg (lower end of dose range) and monitor CK if muscle symptoms occur

interactions_checked.interaction: Additive diuretic effect may cause volume depletion and orthostatic hypotension
interactions_checked.action: Advise adequate hydration; consider thiazide dose reduction to 12.5 mg (as proposed) and monitor blood pressure and symptoms
